Ok, the schedule has been updated. There was no off the shelf generator I could find for 9 teams 14 weeks, so I made a custom one. I was able to get it so everyone played their division rivals twice, and all other teams at least once. Everyone plays the league average either once or twice (which thankfully, the site does support). All slots were randomized. The only thing that looks off is the home/away ratio for some teams, but since that doesn't make any difference I'm just going to call it good.

Just a reminder, we have a blind bidding system that processes every Wednesday night, starting tonight. So if you want to bid on anyone, get those into the site by 11pm. Remember to put the number of years you want to sign them for in the comments.

After blind bidding processes then it's free for all pickups for $1 until game time Sunday.

Well that was unexpected! So many injuries across the league this season definitely made things interesting. Not sure my team deserves a championship but I guess 'any given sunday'? It was a wild ride... Looking forward to next year everyone.
